Cf. Hārahūṇa, pl.
Huṇḍa, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 50, 2081 (only C., B. has Pauṇḍrāḥ, in the army of Yudhishṭhira).
